# Generated program/bootstrap evidence probe

This repository-only .NET 10 fixture compiles a canonical multi-file BAML
program as one private hexadecimal generated array. It verifies compiler-byte
identity, SHA-256 metadata, `Lazy` concurrency/failure caching, process-global
same-program reuse and conflict rejection, pre-native integrity failure, and
actual native rejection of structurally corrupt matching-fingerprint bytes.

Its `boundary` mode loads the compiled private field, compares every byte and
its SHA-256 with a deterministic synthetic input, and scans the generated
source for exactly one private `byte[]` and no Base64/resource alternate.
Synthetic bytes and generated source are normal ephemeral tool outputs; they
are not checked into the repository.

The generated carrier is supplied explicitly to this evidence project through
`BamlGeneratedProgramSource`. This is not a product MSBuild generation target;
the production workflow remains explicit `baml generate` followed by an
ordinary user-project build. Builds must also select
`BamlNativeProbeMode=Direct` or `Package`; package mode requires the isolated
evidence feed.

name: Test Rust SDK Cross-Platform

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [canary, main]
    paths:
      - "languages/rust/**"
      - "engine/**/*.rs"
      - "engine/**/*.proto"
      - ".github/actions/setup-protoc/**"
      - ".github/actions/engine-setup-rust/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-rust-sdk.yml"
  push:
    branches: [canary]
    paths:
      - "languages/rust/**"
      - "engine/**/*.rs"
      - "engine/**/*.proto"
      - ".github/actions/setup-protoc/**"
      - ".github/actions/engine-setup-rust/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test-rust-sdk.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test-windows:
    name: Test Windows Rust SDK
    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-windows-2025

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Engine Rust
        uses: ./.github/actions/engine-setup-rust
        with:
          toolchain: "1.83"
          enable-cache: false
          enable-cross: false
          skip-protoc: true

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies (engine)
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: engine
          prefix-key: engine

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies (languages/rust)
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: languages/rust
          prefix-key: rust-sdk

      - name: Setup Go (for protoc-gen-go)
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "1.22"
          cache: false

      - name: Install protoc-gen-go
        run: |
          go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.34.1
          echo "$HOME/go/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        shell: bash

      - name: Install Protoc
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-protoc

      - name: Build CFFI Library
        run: |
          cargo build --release -p baml_cffi
        working-directory: engine
        shell: bash

      - name: List built artifacts
        run: |
          echo "Listing release directory:"
          dir engine\target\release\*.dll
        shell: cmd

      - name: Set BAML Library Path
        run: |
          echo "BAML_LIBRARY_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}\engine\target\release\baml_cffi.dll" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        shell: bash

      - name: Run Rust SDK Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace -v
        working-directory: languages/rust
        shell: bash
        env:
          BAML_LOG: DEBUG

      - name: Build Rust SDK
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace
        working-directory: languages/rust
        shell: bash

  test-unix:
    name: Test Unix Rust SDK
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Engine Rust
        uses: ./.github/actions/engine-setup-rust
        with:
          toolchain: "1.83"
          enable-cache: false
          enable-cross: false
          skip-protoc: true

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies (engine)
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: engine
          prefix-key: engine

      - name: Cache Rust dependencies (languages/rust)
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: languages/rust
          prefix-key: rust-sdk

      - name: Setup Go (for protoc-gen-go)
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "1.22"
          cache: false

      - name: Install protoc-gen-go
        run: |
          go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.34.1
          echo "$HOME/go/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        shell: bash

      - name: Install Protoc
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-protoc

      - name: Build CFFI Library
        run: |
          cargo build --release -p baml_cffi
        working-directory: engine

      - name: List built artifacts
        run: |
          echo "Listing release directory:"
          ls -la engine/target/release/libbaml_cffi.* || true
          ls -la engine/target/release/baml_cffi.* || true

      - name: Set BAML Library Path (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          echo "BAML_LIBRARY_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}/engine/target/release/libbaml_cffi.so" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set BAML Library Path (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          echo "BAML_LIBRARY_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}/engine/target/release/libbaml_cffi.dylib" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Rust SDK Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace -v
        working-directory: languages/rust
        env:
          BAML_LOG: DEBUG

      - name: Build Rust SDK
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace
        working-directory: languages/rust

# Test-side runtime + macros for the `sdk_tests/crates/<generator>/`
# crates, wired in as their `[dev-dependencies]`.
#
# Holds:
#   - `run_test_cmd` / `run_test_cmd_with_env` — runtime helpers
#     called from every per-fixture `#[test]` body.
#   - `<generator>::test_suite!` — one per generator; each takes the
#     crate's `fixture <name>;` rows and expands to a `mod <fixture>`
#     per row holding that generator's toolchain checks.
#   - `setup_guard!` — asserts the crate's setup.sh ran this run.
#   - `fixtures` + `fixture_manifest!` — the shared corpus table and
#     the oracle pinning each crate's rows against it.
#
# Std-only deps, so it can ride along in `[dev-dependencies]` without
# dragging the sdkgen crates or the compiler onto the test-binary
# compile path. `sdk_test_codegen` depends on it too, for the one
# fixture table both sides must agree on.
#
# Package named `sdk_test_*` so cargo-stow's
# `ignore_crates = ["sdk_test_*"]` rule (see baml_language/stow.toml)
# covers it; the folder name stays short.
[package]
name = "sdk_test_harness_runner"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

[package]
name = "sdk_test_typescript_web"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false


[dev-dependencies]
sdk_test_harness_runner = { path = "../../harness_runner" }

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

# Rust sdk-test crate. Three toolchain checks per fixture (rustfmt, clippy,
# cargo test) over the SDK crate generated at `<fixture>/generated/` — Cargo
# manifest at the root, sources under `src/`, ported tests gated through
# `tests/main.rs`.
#
# Both the codegen and the per-fixture `cargo test --no-run` pre-warm come from
# `setup.sh`, which nextest fires via its setup-script binding — nothing is
# generated during an ordinary build. `sdk_test_harness_runner` supplies the
# `test_suite!` macro that declares the tests.
[package]
name = "sdk_test_rust"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false


[dev-dependencies]
sdk_test_harness_runner = { path = "../../harness_runner" }

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

# Swift sdk-test crate. One `swift test` per fixture over the SwiftPM package
# generated at `<fixture>/generated/` (Package.swift + Sources/Baml/ +
# Tests/BamlTests/).
#
# Both the codegen and the XCFramework build come from `setup.sh`, which
# nextest fires on macOS via .config/nextest.toml — nothing is generated during
# an ordinary build. `sdk_test_harness_runner` supplies the `test_suite!` macro

[package]
name = "sdk_test_swift"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false


[dev-dependencies]
sdk_test_harness_runner = { path = "../../harness_runner" }

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

# C++ sdk-test crate. Two toolchain test invocations per fixture (compile,

#

# Python + pydantic2 sdk-test crate. Three toolchain checks per fixture
# (ruff, pyright, pytest) over the SDK generated at
# `<fixture>/generated/baml_sdk/`, alongside a `pyproject.toml` + `.venv/`.
#
# Both the codegen and `uv sync` come from `setup.sh`, which nextest fires via
# its setup-script binding — nothing is generated during an ordinary build.
# `sdk_test_harness_runner` supplies the `test_suite!` macro that declares the
# tests.
[package]
name = "sdk_test_python_pydantic2"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false


[dev-dependencies]
sdk_test_harness_runner = { path = "../../harness_runner" }

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

# Recorder for the streaming **replay harness**
# (thoughts/sam-projects/bridge-generics/streaming/02). Owns the checked-in
# recordings under `sdk_tests/fixtures/llm_functions/recordings/`: a
# CI-enforced text snapshot of the redacted streaming request (drift detector,
# keyless) plus an insta binary snapshot of the raw SSE body (`.snap.sse`,
# served verbatim by the BAML replay server).
#
# Neither sibling crate can host this: `sdk_test_codegen` carries the
# compiler and sdkgen closure but not the engine, and
# `sdk_test_harness_runner` is deliberately std-only. The recorder needs
# the engine (to invoke the fixture request helper backed by the
# native-BAML provider lowering) + insta
# + the network, so it is its own crate. It is also generator-agnostic
# (recordings feed both the Python and TS replay tests), so it does not belong
# inside a per-generator crate.
#
# Package named `sdk_test_*` so cargo-stow's `ignore_crates = ["sdk_test_*"]`
# rule (baml_language/stow.toml) covers it; the folder name stays short.
[package]
name = "sdk_test_llm_recordings"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dev-dependencies]
# `baml_tests::engine` re-exports `compile_multi_file` / `run_compiled` /
# `IndexMap` (the same deterministic engine path doc 00's pins use).
baml_tests = { path = "../../../crates/baml_tests" }
bex_engine = { workspace = true }
# `filters` adds `Settings::add_filter` (belt-and-braces key redaction); the
# workspace default features are only `yaml` + `redactions`.
insta = { workspace = true, features = [ "filters" ] }
tokio = { workspace = true, features = [ "rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net" ] }

[package.metadata.ci]
wasm_support = false

[project]
name = "__PYPROJECT_NAME__"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "baml_bridge",
    "pydantic>=2",
    # `UNSET` is a `typing_extensions.Sentinel` (PEP 661); recognizing a
    # sentinel in a type expression needs pyright >= 1.1.410.
    "typing-extensions>=4.14.0",
    "pytest>=7",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23",
    "ruff",
    "pyright>=1.1.410",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = []

[tool.uv]
package = false

[tool.uv.sources]
baml_bridge = { path = "../../../../../sdks/python", editable = true }

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["."]
# Put the generated tree root (where `baml_sdk/` lives) on sys.path so
# test modules in nested dirs (e.g. `roundtrip_tests/`) can still
# `import baml_sdk`. Top-level test modules already get this via the
# default `prepend` import mode; this makes it hold for subdirs too.
pythonpath = ["."]
python_files = ["test_*.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
addopts = "-v"
asyncio_mode = "auto"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
extend-exclude = ["*.pyi"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
ignore = ["F401", "F821", "E402"]

[tool.pyright]
include = ["baml_sdk", "*_static.py"]
exclude = [".venv", "test_*.py"]
reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment = true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Native setup for the sdk_test_swift crate.
#
# Invoked automatically by `cargo nextest run` via the setup-script
# binding in `baml_language/.config/nextest.toml` — whenever the run
# selects any sdk_test_swift test on a macOS host. For plain
# `cargo test` (no nextest) run this manually after
# `cargo test --no-run` populates each fixture's generated/ package.
#
# One responsibility: build (or incrementally rebuild) the host-arch
# `bridge_swift` staticlib and assemble it into
# `sdks/swift/Binaries/BamlBridgeFFI.xcframework` — the binary target
# every fixture's path dependency on `sdks/swift` links against.
# Debug profile, so the cargo cache is shared with the rest of the
# nextest workspace build and steady-state reruns are incremental.
#
# Re-run after bridge Rust changes (the xcframework needs
# reassembling) or after adding a new fixture.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"  # baml_language/sdk_tests/crates/swift

WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"

# Generate each fixture's SwiftPM package first: nothing else produces it, and
# `swift test` builds against it.
echo "==> sdk_test_codegen swift (generate fixture packages)"
(cd "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" && cargo run --quiet -p sdk_test_codegen -- swift)

echo "==> build-xcframework.sh --host-only (bridge_swift staticlib)"
"$WORKSPACE_ROOT/sdks/swift/scripts/build-xcframework.sh" --host-only

# Per-run breadcrumb for the in-test guard. nextest reads $NEXTEST_ENV
# after this script and injects these vars into the matched tests'
# processes — so `setup_guard::ran` (see harness_runner) can prove
# this script ran *this* run. Keep the var name in sync with
# SETUP_ENV_VAR in codegen/src/swift.rs.
if [[ -n "${NEXTEST_ENV:-}" ]]; then
    echo "SDK_TEST_SWIFT_SETUP=1" >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"

# Generate each fixture's baml_sdk/, go.mod and go.sum first: nothing else
# produces them, and the `go mod tidy` loop below silently skips any fixture
# whose generated/ is missing.
echo "==> sdk_test_codegen go (generate fixture SDKs)"
(cd "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" && cargo run --quiet -p sdk_test_codegen -- go)

(cd "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" && cargo build -p bridge_cffi)

go_bin="go"
if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    go_bin="$(mise which go)"
fi
for fixture_dir in */generated; do
    [[ -d "$fixture_dir" ]] || continue
    (cd "$fixture_dir" && env -u GOROOT "$go_bin" mod tidy)
done

if [[ -n "${NEXTEST_ENV:-}" ]]; then
    echo "SDK_TEST_GO_SETUP=1" >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
workspace_root="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"

# Generate every fixture's baml_sdk/ client first: nothing else produces it,
# and the solution build below compiles it. Runs before the CARGO_TARGET_DIR
# reads so the driver builds into the ordinary workspace target dir.
(cd "$workspace_root" && cargo run --quiet -p sdk_test_codegen -- csharp)

(cd "$workspace_root" && cargo build -p bridge_cffi)

target_dir="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$workspace_root/target}"
if [[ "$target_dir" != /* ]]; then
  target_dir="$workspace_root/$target_dir"
fi
target_dir="$(cd "$target_dir" && pwd -P)"
case "$(uname -s)" in
  Darwin) native_library="$target_dir/debug/libbridge_cffi.dylib" ;;
  *) native_library="$target_dir/debug/libbridge_cffi.so" ;;
esac

# Build every fixture consumer (and the union-generator tool) in ONE
# MSBuild invocation: the projects compile in parallel across cores and the
# shared Baml.Bridge project builds exactly once. The tests then run with
# --no-build, which is what makes it safe for nextest to run them
# concurrently — at test time no MSBuild processes exist to race on the
# bridge's shared obj/ (the historical reason this suite was serialized).
dotnet build Fixtures.slnx --configuration Release -m --nologo

# The documentation consumer swaps its package reference for a project
# reference via these properties, so it cannot ride along in the solution
# build; its test passes the same properties with --no-build.
dotnet build \
  "$workspace_root/sdks/csharp/bridge_csharp/tests/Baml.Bridge.DocumentationConsumer/Baml.Bridge.DocumentationConsumer.csproj" \
  --configuration Release --nologo \
  "-p:BamlBridgeProjectReference=$workspace_root/sdks/csharp/bridge_csharp/src/Baml.Bridge.csproj" \
  "-p:BamlGeneratedSourceRoot=$(pwd)/basic_calls/baml_sdk"

if [[ -n "${NEXTEST_ENV:-}" ]]; then
  echo "SDK_TEST_CSHARP_SETUP=1" >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
  echo "BAML_BRIDGE_CSHARP_NATIVE_LIBRARY=$native_library" >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Web/Wasm bridge and generated fixture setup for sdk_test_typescript_web.
# The canonical checked-in tests live in the sibling typescript crate and are
# copied into this crate's generated trees by `sdk_test_codegen`, below.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"
BRIDGE_TYPESCRIPT_WEB="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/sdks/typescript/bridge_typescript_web"

# Generate each fixture's Web and Workers trees first: nothing else produces
# them, and the per-fixture `pnpm install` loop below silently skips any
# fixture whose generated/ is missing.
echo "==> sdk_test_codegen typescript_web (generate fixture SDKs)"
(cd "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" && cargo run --quiet -p sdk_test_codegen -- typescript_web)

export npm_config_store_dir="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/target/pnpm-store"
mkdir -p "$npm_config_store_dir"

echo "==> pnpm install in sdks/typescript/bridge_typescript_web"
(cd "$BRIDGE_TYPESCRIPT_WEB" && pnpm install)

echo "==> pnpm build:debug in sdks/typescript/bridge_typescript_web"
(cd "$BRIDGE_TYPESCRIPT_WEB" && pnpm build:debug)

for fixture_dir in */generated; do
    [[ -d "$fixture_dir" ]] || continue
    echo "==> pnpm install in $fixture_dir"
    (cd "$fixture_dir" && pnpm install --force --ignore-workspace --ignore-scripts)
    (cd "$fixture_dir" && pnpm update @boundaryml/baml-bridge-web --force --ignore-workspace --ignore-scripts)
done

for fixture_dir in */generated; do
    [[ -d "$fixture_dir" ]] || continue
    echo "==> playwright install chromium"
    (cd "$fixture_dir" && pnpm exec playwright install chromium)
    break
done

if [[ -n "${NEXTEST_ENV:-}" ]]; then
    echo "SDK_TEST_TYPESCRIPT_WEB_SETUP=1" >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
TEST_ROOT="$PWD"
WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd ../../.. && pwd)"
TARGET_DIR="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$WORKSPACE_ROOT/target}"
if [[ "$TARGET_DIR" != /* ]]; then
  TARGET_DIR="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$TARGET_DIR"
fi
FIXTURE_DIR="$TARGET_DIR/ruby-bridge-fixtures"
INCLUDE_DIR="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/crates/bridge_cffi/include"
mkdir -p "$FIXTURE_DIR"

(
  cd "$WORKSPACE_ROOT"
  cargo build -p bridge_cffi
  cargo run --quiet -p sdk_test_codegen -- \
    emit-bytecode --fixture function_calls \
    --out "$FIXTURE_DIR/function-calls.bytecode"
)

if [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Darwin" ]]; then
  LIB_EXT="dylib"
  C_SHARED=( -dynamiclib )
  CXX_SHARED=( -dynamiclib )
  REAL_RUNTIME="$TARGET_DIR/debug/libbridge_cffi.dylib"
else
  LIB_EXT="so"
  C_SHARED=( -shared -fPIC )
  CXX_SHARED=( -shared -fPIC -pthread )
  REAL_RUNTIME="$TARGET_DIR/debug/libbridge_cffi.so"
fi

cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L \
  "${C_SHARED[@]}" -pthread -I"$INCLUDE_DIR" \
  "$TEST_ROOT/test/native/bridge_fixture.c" \
  -o "$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_test_fixture.$LIB_EXT"
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
  "${C_SHARED[@]}" \
  "$TEST_ROOT/test/native/missing_getter.c" \
  -o "$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_missing_getter.$LIB_EXT"
c++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
  "${CXX_SHARED[@]}" \
  "$TEST_ROOT/test/native/thread_callback.cpp" \
  -o "$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_thread_callback.$LIB_EXT"
printf 'not a dynamic library\n' > "$FIXTURE_DIR/not-a-library"

export BUNDLE_GEMFILE="$TEST_ROOT/Gemfile"
export BUNDLE_PATH="$TARGET_DIR/ruby-bundle"
ruby -S bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

if [[ -n "${NEXTEST_ENV:-}" ]]; then
  {
    echo "SDK_TEST_RUBY_SORBET_SETUP=1"
    echo "BUNDLE_GEMFILE=$BUNDLE_GEMFILE"
    echo "BUNDLE_PATH=$BUNDLE_PATH"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_FIXTURE=$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_test_fixture.$LIB_EXT"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_MISSING_GETTER=$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_missing_getter.$LIB_EXT"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_INVALID_LIBRARY=$FIXTURE_DIR/not-a-library"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_THREAD_FIXTURE=$FIXTURE_DIR/libbaml_ruby_thread_callback.$LIB_EXT"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_REAL_RUNTIME=$REAL_RUNTIME"
    echo "BAML_RUBY_TEST_REAL_BYTECODE=$FIXTURE_DIR/function-calls.bytecode"
  } >> "$NEXTEST_ENV"
fi
